name: Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon (5th ed.)
short_description: A multi-distance road race in Hanoi, Vietnam, featuring a full marathon among six distance options, scheduled for October 4, 2026.
ai_summary: The Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon returns for its 5th edition on October 4, 2026, in Hanoi, Vietnam. The event offers six distance options, from a full marathon (42.195km) down to a short 1.5km fun run, catering to a wide range of participants. The exact start venue within Hanoi has not yet been specified, and registration has not yet opened.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km, 3km, 1.5km) suit runners of varying abilities
Full marathon distance available as the primary event for serious runners
Takes place in Hanoi, a major international city in Vietnam
Now in its 5th edition, suggesting an established, recurring event
cons: Exact start venue within Hanoi has not been specified
Registration status is not yet announced, so entry details are unavailable
research_highlights: The course runs through Hanoi's heritage and cultural landmarks, including the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the National Assembly, and Long Bien Bridge.
All four distances (42.195km marathon, 21.097km half marathon, 10km, and 5km) are AIMS-certified courses, also recognized by the Vietnam Athletics Federation.
The 2025 (4th) edition drew over 13,000 runners from 51 countries and territories, up roughly 1.5x from the prior year.
Race day weather for the 2025 edition (Oct 4-5) was recorded at about 27°C with overcast skies and very high humidity (~90%), typical for early October in Hanoi.

The event is organized by Sunrise Events Vietnam (also organizers of IRONMAN Vietnam) with Techcombank as title sponsor, and includes a 'Marathon Village' with expo activities in the days before the race.
research_watchouts: High humidity (around 90%) reported on race morning in October, which can make conditions muggy despite moderate air temperature.
As a large, fast-growing event (13,000+ participants and increasing year over year), expect crowded start corrals and busy heritage-route sections near central landmarks.

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The 5th edition of the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon is scheduled to take place on October 4, 2026. This date has been confirmed for the event, which is held in Hanoi, Vietnam, though further specific venue details have not yet been provided.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this marathon?
faqs.answer: The race offers six distance options to accommodate different runner levels: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, plus 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km races. The 42.195km full marathon serves as the primary featured distance of the event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon?
faqs.answer: Registration status for this event has not yet been announced. At this time, there is no confirmed information available regarding when registration will open, associated costs, or how participants can sign up for any of the six available distances.

faqs.question: Where exactly does the race start in Hanoi?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in Hanoi, Vietnam, but the exact start point within the city has not been stated in available information. Further details about the specific venue or starting location are expected to be announced closer to the event date.
